messages:
Priya S.: Quick note: our onboarding sample app is noisy under strict typechecking. The SDK-generated response models and stream chunks are loosely typed (Any/dict), which causes mypy/pyright failures in examples. Minimal repro:
```py
resp = await client.chat.create(prompt=\"hello\")
# mypy: \"Item has type Any\" when doing resp.output[0].text

async for chunk in client.chat.stream(prompt=\"hi\"):
    # pyright: Property 'text' does not exist on type 'dict'
    print(chunk[\"text\"])
```

Marco (sdk): Thanks, Priya. We're aware. Short-term fixes we can ship in a 0.9.x patch: tighten param typing (map integer/number/boolean/string to int/float/bool/str), emit Optional[...] for nullable fields, and produce a shallow TypedDict for stream chunks with known keys (text, role, finished).

Jordan L.: Shallow TypedDict for streams would cut most pyright noise. Also, can we emit a generic Response[T] and annotate non-streaming client methods -> Response[Model]? Right now everything is -> Any.

Marco (sdk): Agreed. Medium-term plan for 0.10.0-alpha:
- Add a Response[T] generic wrapper and update method stubs to return Response[Model] for non-streaming calls.
- Generate .pyi stubs for the public client surface so strict typecheckers see accurate signatures without forcing runtime parsing overhead.
- For streams, change AsyncIterator[Any] -> AsyncIterator[TypedChunk] where TypedChunk is a TypedDict with optional fields. The conversion will be shallow for perf.

Priya S.: Important to include examples/typed_chat.py and examples/typed_stream.py that are clean under mypy and pyright. New hires run those; if they fail, onboarding blocks. Also add a CI job that runs pyright on examples.

Marco (sdk): Will add both examples and a lightweight pyright/mypy CI job. Also planning a client flag: typed_responses: bool = True (opt-out to raw dicts for perf-sensitive apps) and return_raw_stream: bool = False. Default will be typed_responses=True but well add migration docs.

Jordan L.: For .pyi stubs: include overloads for sync vs async variants and ensure param annotations (temperature: float | None, max_tokens: int | None) are correct. Teams vendoring stubs for CI will appreciate that.

Marco (sdk): Good call. We'll also map oneOf -> Union[...] when safe and use Literal[...] for enum-like fields. And well add pydantic v1/v2 compatibility shims when generating models; include minimum supported pydantic version in README.

DevEx: Please cc devex on the PR so we can update onboarding docs and templates. Also add a short migration note describing how to opt into raw dicts or vendor stubs-only to avoid runtime changes.

types-bot: Created ticket SDK-TYP-501: \"python-sdk: .pyi stubs + Response[T] + TypedChunk + stricter param typings + examples CI\" assigned to @marco_sdk

Priya S.: Thanks. Small wins (shallow TypedDict + param types) will reduce noise immediately; full stubs + examples will be huge for DX. Looking forward to the PR.

Marco (sdk): I'll draft generator template updates and a tiny .pyi emitter. Targeting the param/stream patch within a week and the full stubs/examples in the alpha release. Will ping here when the PR is open.
